response: ["For low-risk primary basal cell carcinoma, surgical excision with 4‑mm clinical margins is recommended.","For low‑risk primary basal cell carcinoma, histologic margin assessment is recommended.","A treatment plan that considers recurrence rate, preservation of function, patient expectations, and potential adverse effects is recommended.","Surgery with 3‑D histology shall be offered in high‑risk basal cell carcinoma.","High‑risk basal cell carcinoma includes recurrent tumors.","High‑risk basal cell carcinoma includes aggressive subtypes.","High‑risk basal cell carcinoma includes tumors located in critical anatomical sites.","High‑risk basal cell carcinoma includes tumors with poorly defined margins."]
